report:
Where things stand — I ran out of turns just as Option 4 was gaining traction.

THE LIST (confirmed by each owner unless marked draft)
#1 (C) CONFIRMED — C wants to do their home project when they planned, without their timeline depending on someone else's schedule.
#2 (B) CONFIRMED — B wants to be able to choose how her pad is used.
#3 (B) CONFIRMED — B wants to keep her word to A and C — not leave them in a bind.
#4 (A) CONFIRMED — A wants to rely on the trailer for weekend trips in the next few weeks, and to know in enough time to make other plans if it isn't available.
#5 (B) worded and accepted by B ("#5 fits") but I had not yet formally recorded it: B wants a plan that doesn't depend on the trailer staying on her pad.
#6 (C) worded and accepted by C ("#6 fits") but I had not yet formally recorded it: C wants a weekday block long enough for the project, with the dates fixed in advance.

UNRESOLVED (recorded as unresolved, not settled)
- Storage location: all three are open to a site other than B's pad, but no site has been chosen.
- Cost/cost sharing: no one has a position yet.
- Upkeep: no one has a position yet.
- Decision process: no one has a position yet.
- B's landlord permission: only relevant if the trailer stays on B's pad; B has not asked.

OPTION STATUS
- Option 1 (weekday block for C + weekends for A, trailer on B's pad): B said no — leaves it on her pad. C said not yet — block length/dates unresolved.
- Option 2 (C first, then A): A said no — trips would slip past the next few weeks. B said no — same pad concern. C said yes as a fallback if C goes first.
- Option 3 / Option 4 (trailer stored off B's pad; C gets a fixed weekday block long enough for the project; A gets fixed Fri–Sun weekends, all within the next few weeks): A said yes in principle if weekend dates are fixed within the next few weeks; B said it sounds promising but can't say yes until a workable place and costs are agreed; C said it could work but can't confirm until location and dates are agreed, with cost still open.

NEXT STEP: pick a concrete storage site (candidates: a rented lot, A's driveway, C's driveway) with a cost figure, and propose specific dates — a project block and fixed weekend dates — then bring that single package back to all three for a plain yes/no, including minor discomforts. Nothing has been agreed yet.
